office.remit: The superintendent is the district's chief executive, hired by and reporting to a five-member elected school board. The board adopts the budget and policies, sets attendance areas, approves contracts and the monthly claims list and employs all staff (SDCL 13-10-2, 13-8-39). The business manager keeps the district's books and pays claims. Student transportation is contracted to a private bus company. The superintendent's office answers family and taxpayer mail, prepares board packets, and oversees buildings and grounds, transportation, food service, teaching and learning, and communications.

succession.rule: South Dakota school superintendents are not elected; the school board employs them. SDCL 13-10-2: 'The school board shall have the power to employ personnel deemed necessary by the board and to define the duties and fix the compensation of each.' SDCL 13-8-39 gives the board general charge of the schools and power to 'employ any necessary personnel'. Interviews of candidates may be held in executive session (SDCL 1-25-2(1), 'qualifications of any current or prospective public officer or employee'), but 'Any official action concerning the matters considered pursuant to this section must be taken at an open official meeting.'
succession.timeline: Fri Aug 21, 2026: the previous superintendent's resignation effective (no reason given anywhere). Aug 24: board names Assistant Superintendent Craig Tollefsrud acting superintendent. Sept 8-10: board interviews three finalists in executive session. Mon Sept 14 (regular meeting): board votes 5-0 in open session to employ Lauren Hegdahl as superintendent, contract through June 30, 2028. Mon Sept 21: first day.

how_the_office_works: Verified 2026-10-07 from Watertown board minutes (April 13 and November 10, 2025 and 2026): the board approves verified claims and salaries monthly by motion ('Kari Lohr moved the approval of the verified claims...'); the district has a business manager and an assistant superintendent; transportation is contracted to a private company; food service buys from distributors. Board meetings are the second Monday of the month (Sept 14 and Oct 12, 2026), with fourth-Monday work sessions in this build. SD K-12 staff email addresses use first.last@k12.sd.us.
